notes: Forty-seven source and sixty-four target tokens each partitioned once; forty-six units, since מֵעַל fuses.

The two articles are read in opposite directions and both are right: at s018 the suffix on לֵב licenses the phrase's single determiner their, so the article is unrepresented under rule 41's rider; at s029 the ASV writes a relative which and the article takes it.

Both אֵת markers take a with by which the English verb reaches its object (rule 16's first family): drop the word and only the object relation is diminished. The margin's 'I have broken for myself their etc.' is not the text aligned.
אֲשֶׁר and its resumptive שָׁם are held apart by the verb, so rule 30's contiguity condition is unmet: the relative alone carries whither and שָׁם is unrepresented under rule 22.
מֵעַל → from fuses under rule 30 and heads on מִן, which carries the separative lexeme; marking עַל unrepresented beside a from on מִן is the competing reading.
